calibration_C.estimation_contract: freeze immutable public model revisions and hashes, fixed bins plus quartiles, explicit missingness and abstention, bootstrap uncertainty with public seed 42, and one governed commitment before generation
calibration_C.limitations: small feature set only; measured and unavailable features reported separately; no full distributional calibration claim
calibration_C.disclosure: export only approved compact non-identifying bins targets uncertainty and commitment; never raw media text vocabulary embeddings row-level statistics IDs or reconstructive combinations
calibration_C.episode_plan: freeze a public nonrestricted episode-plan distribution matched feature-by-feature to approved targets using only public lexical resources and no sealed evaluation concepts or outcomes

nested_order: HMAC-SHA-256(secret_budget_key, UTF8('train-budget') || UTF8(opaque_session_id)); then HMAC-SHA-256(secret_budget_key, UTF8('train-item') || UTF8(opaque_media_id))
acquisition: stop after exactly 1.0 credited real hour plus 10 percent accepted-yield reserve; retain keyed resumability; extend to nested 3.0 hours only if Real-1h fails
credited_time: union of unique accepted source-timeline ASR windows with decodable eligible frames; adapter abstentions receive zero
checkpoint_rule: same prospectively fixed objective-step count and final successfully completed checkpoint for matched real and synthetic arms; no arm-specific tuning stopping or selection
initialized_baseline: evaluate byte-identical 0h initialization before training without adapting any rule

real_1h_gate.temporal_rule: Recall@1 and MRR must both be finite and neither may decline by more than 0.05 absolute from initialized

generator_gate.selection_basis: user-directed lower-cost selection consistent with the completed blinded bakeoff lead; Gemini 27/28 with zero critical failures, MiniMax H3 25/28, Seedance 24/28, LTX 19/28
generator_gate.current_price: $17.50 per million video-output tokens at 5792 tokens/second of 720p video, approximately $0.10/second; text input $1.50 per million tokens
generator_gate.privacy: paid API only; public/self-authored nonrestricted episode plans only; never ChildLens/BabyView input, derivatives, restricted vocabulary, evaluation concepts/assets, or governed prompts
generator_gate.storage: store=false inline response; paid-service prompts and responses may still be logged for a limited abuse-monitoring period and may be processed in countries where Google or its agents operate
generator_gate.output_rights: Google does not claim ownership of generated content; user remains responsible for lawful use
generator_gate.audio: discard native audio when retaining frozen modular German TTS

synthetic_arm: only after real learnability and generator gates pass; exactly match accepted credited duration and objective steps
directionally_competitive_rule: both trained arms improve realistic macro by at least 0.02 over initialization and synthetic-real absolute macro gap is at most 0.05
